patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and Demandbase share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose BookYourData only if your buying job matches “Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go cre” rather than Demandbase's shape. Choose Demandbase only if your buying job matches “Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-marke” rather than BookYourData's shape. Workflow advantage: BookYourData leans email-outreach; Demandbase leans data-enrichment. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — BookYourData and Demandbase share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: BookYourData is Real-time B2B contact database for building verified prospect lists with pay-as-you-go credits and a 97% deliverability guarantee.; Demandbase is Enterprise ABM platform (Demandbase One) for account intelligence, intent, and go-to-market orchestration — custom-quote packaging..
- Workflow coverage skew: BookYourData-leaning email-outreach vs Demandbase-leaning data-enrichment.
- Researched limits: BookYourData — none listed; Demandbase — Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices.

Limitations — BookYourData: —; Demandbase: Demandbase One pricing is custom quote only — no published seat list prices; Enterprise ABM scope means substantial implementation and change-management cost.
